claim_boundary: External evidence supports nonreportable positioning as a potentially informative retail-or-small-participant state and links its weekly change to CME Bitcoin futures basis, but does not establish this exact net-percent-of-open-interest continuation rule, subsequent spot-BTC returns, or a tradable long/cash alpha. The rule is one transparent falsifiable experiment, not a replication claim.
causal_hypothesis: A weekly increase in nonreportable long-minus-short share of CME Bitcoin futures open interest may reflect smaller-participant demand that persists into subsequent BTC returns, while a decline may identify a less supportive demand state.
economic_hypothesis: A full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy using one causally lagged nonreportable weekly net-position-change signal may preserve sufficient BTC upside while improving fee- and adverse-slippage-adjusted drawdown and Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold.

frozen_feature.availability_rationale: Day seven at 00:00 UTC is conservatively after the frozen three-to-six-calendar-day release window without reconstructing unsealed historical receipt times.

primary_sources.title: CFTC Commitments of Traders Explanatory Notes
primary_sources.use: Official semantics: nonreportable long and short positions are derived residuals after subtracting reportable positions from total open interest; trader count and commercial classification are unknown.

primary_sources.title: Crypto carry, BIS Working Papers No 1087
primary_sources.use: Direction relevance prior: the paper reports that a 1,000-contract weekly increase in nonreportable CME Bitcoin futures positions is correlated with a 0.2 percent increase in one-month basis. This is basis evidence, not subsequent BTC-return proof.

primary_sources.title: Bitcoin futures risk premia
primary_sources.use: Variable relevance prior: the published abstract reports that trading activity and extreme sentiment of speculators and retailers predict subsequent Bitcoin futures price changes across horizons, without exposing this exact field, sign rule or long/cash economics.

primary_sources.title: Who Trades Bitcoin Futures and Why?
primary_sources.use: Structural warning: CME Bitcoin trader composition changed materially around 2020 and micro-contract participants differ from the full-size contract, requiring Validation and annual breadth rather than aggregate-fit acceptance.

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_total_open_interest: The closed total-open-interest family measured market-level contract creation without direction. This family uses the separately reported residual long-minus-short share and asks a directional smaller-participant demand question.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_reportable_categori: Closed CFTC families used Dealer, Leveraged Money, Asset Manager or Other Reportables categories. This family uses only NonRept residual long and short fields.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.shared_source_risk: All CFTC families reuse the same CME TFF weekly archive, release clock and BTC corpus; category difference is a mechanism hypothesis, not independent data-source replication.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.pre_economic_nonredundancy_gate: In both Design and Validation, absolute Spearman correlation of the nonreportable weekly delta with each closed Dealer, Leveraged Money and Asset Manager weekly delta must be at most 0.80; otherwise permanently close as DUPLICATE_REJECT before strategy economics.

adversarial_prior: Nonreportable positions are arithmetic residuals, not identified retail accounts; unknown traders, hedges and rounding can contaminate a small-participant interpretation.
A positive association with futures basis does not imply positive subsequent spot-BTC return and may instead reflect contemporaneous demand or expensive carry.
Smaller traders may trend-chase after BTC moves, so weekly position changes can be reactive and fail an independent next-week predictive gate.
CME trader composition changed around 2020 and after futures-based ETFs and micro contracts, so any Design relation may fail 2023-2024 Validation.
The residual category may be mechanically correlated with reportable categories; passing economic gates cannot rescue a failed nonredundancy gate.
stop_conditions: Stop DATA_REJECT before factor evaluation if any archive hash, exact contract row count, ordered field identity, Tuesday report date, exact seven-day predecessor, ION exclusion, percentage grammar or BTC H1 corpus identity fails.

Stop DUPLICATE_REJECT before strategy economics if either Design or Validation nonreportable-delta absolute Spearman correlation exceeds 0.80 against any closed Dealer, Leveraged Money or Asset Manager delta.
Stop NO_CANDIDATE before strategy economics if any frozen Design or Validation predictive breadth, sign, concentration or path gate fails.

If predictive gates pass, stop NO_CANDIDATE unless the single primary passes every frozen normal/stress Design, Validation, annual breadth, drawdown, Calmar, upside, concentration, holding and terminal-inventory economic gate.

Do not invert the continuation direction or scan a level, raw contracts, threshold, lookback, percentile, smoothing, lag, horizon, evaluation time, position size, leverage or short leg after factor or outcome access.
Do not combine this factor with reportable categories, total open interest, basis, funding, price, volatility, macro, on-chain, DRA or any closed mechanism as a rescue.
Do not open post-2024 BTC outcomes. Any historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires independently sealed OOS.
